svg.title: Edge caching
svg.desc: An edge cache holds the response for /api/products/123 with a 60 second TTL and a product tag. Requests are answered at the edge while the TTL counts down. When it expires, one request goes to the product API and the copy is refreshed. Then a price change purges the tag, the copy vanishes at once, and the next request fetches a fresh one.
svg.text: The edge serves its copy until the TTL runs out or a purge clears it.
